title: Build a graph adjacency list
summary: Represent an unweighted graph on vertices 0 through n−1 with one neighbor set per vertex. Directed edges go one way and undirected edges go both ways.
triggers: sparse graph given as an edge list
iterate only over neighbors of the current vertex
prompts: Build a neighbor index for a set of one-way cycle lanes.
Record friendships so every person, including someone with no friends, has a neighbor entry.
invariant: Each set contains exactly the vertices reachable by one outgoing edge.
mantra: Create every vertex, then add its outgoing edges.
pitfalls: Allocate an independent set for each vertex. Repeating a single set aliases every row.

anchors.name: Find if Path Exists in Graph
anchors.trick: Build neighbor collections before starting the traversal.

mutations.explanation: Reverses the rule for mirroring an edge.
